tools.name: get_current_offer
tools.description: Return any active public discount code, its expiry, and every paid pack's normal and discounted price. Read-only. Returns no offer when none is running.

tools.name: get_buy_link
tools.description: Return the Payhip URL, price, what is inside, proof link, refund line, any active discount code with the discounted price, and the bundle alternative for a paid pack (use slug first-desk for First Desk, which also returns its Professional options). findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_packs, get_buy_link · Public sink: list_packs, recommend_pack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_packs, get_buy_link · Public sink: list_packs, recommend_pack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_packs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
